seo_description: Book your bridal party, birthday or corporate group. Group perks, private Golden Hours and custom packages.
hero_intro: Celebrating something special? Book your group and let us pamper everyone in true Polished style, with group perks, private Golden Hours, and custom packages.
hero_note: Now booking holiday parties, office team outings & bachelorettes for November–December.
steps: On our booking page, select the Services tab.
Select the option that fits your guest size.
Book your appointment to reserve your spot.
steps_note: Book at least 1 week ahead (2–3 weeks for weekends and December).
perks_intro: The bigger the party, the better it gets. Every guest who books a hand service and a foot service unlocks your group's perks.

tiers.name: Groups of 4–5
items: A welcome toast for every guest (21+)
